debug_level.description: Debug logging level (0 = none, 5 = max). Higher values produce more verbose logs.

idle_timeout.description: Idle time in seconds before disconnecting the link. Set to 0 to disable idle timeout.

max_connect_time.description: Maximum duration in seconds for a single connection. 0 means no time limit.

serial_speed.description: Serial port speed in bps (e.g., 115200, 57600). Set to 0 to auto-negotiate (not recommended for most modems).

items.description: IPv4 DNS server address to push to the peer (e.g., '8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.1').

dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers to configure on the peer. Empty = don’t push DNS.

items.description: IPv4 WINS server address to push to Windows peers. Empty = don’t push WINS.

wins_servers.description: List of WINS servers for NetBIOS name resolution on Windows clients.

static_ips.description: If true, use a fixed local:remote IP pair. If false, allow dynamic IP assignment.

local_ip.description: Local IP address (server side) used when static_ips is true. Must match network interface.

remote_ip.description: Remote IP address (client side) assigned when static_ips is true.

mru_size.description: Maximum Receive Unit (MRU) size. Reduce to 1492 for PPPoE to avoid fragmentation.

mtu_size.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) size. Should match network path constraints.

lcp_echo_interval.description: Seconds between LCP echo requests (keepalive). Set 0 to disable.

lcp_echo_failure.description: Number of failed echo replies before considering the link dead.
